decisions.reason: The separate thm-exact-jordan-block-analytic-evaluation-correct already proves successful output equals the primary function: its F1 is exactly the verified finite Jordan sum, and its F2 supplies certificate independence. The procedure makes no stability claim; no repair is needed.

The original statement admits n=0 although f(A) and the contour supplier are defined only for n>=1. Added the missing intended positive-dimension hypothesis. For n>=1 the spectral-neighborhood argument, uniform Neumann remainder, triangular resolvent identity, and absolutely convergent exponential coefficient integral establish every formula; no choice axiom is used. Direct consumers must retain n>=1.

The composition argument used lambda in place of g(lambda), so it did not justify exp(Log(A)) or Log(exp(Y)). Replaced it by g(J)=g(lambda)I+V with V^d=0, proved the outer Taylor formula using the Jordan block sizes of g(J), then substituted the inner jet. The exponential-series identity and separated-spectrum Sylvester uniqueness finish existence and both uniqueness clauses. Statement unchanged; the contract step mirror was updated under the shared lock.

The generic square-system solve is deliberately instantiated on QX=P by step 2 of alg-pade-scaling-and-squaring-exponential, where step 1 constructs Q=q_m(B) and P=p_m(B). It solves with the matrix denominator, not for scalar Pade coefficients. Arbitrary M,C permit its other Newton callers. Exact original-input residual auditing justifies verified-solution through its separate correctness theorem; no missing Pade-system hypothesis exists.

The closing sentence attributed return statuses to an unnamed finite procedure although the only dependency is a contour-bound theorem. Replaced that operational claim by the precise limitation of the mathematical ingredients: the contour estimate needs a validated resolvent bound and exact Parlett reconstruction needs justified solves. This preserves the warning without introducing later algorithm dependencies; the Remark has no Statement or Definition interface.

The admitted n=0 input cannot meet the n,r>=1 preconditions of the denominator solver and makes the row maxima undefined. Added the positive-dimension condition already required by those suppliers. Reviewed complete-candidate gating, exact polynomial and residual arithmetic, explicit before-primitive squaring budget, and conditional contour hypotheses; these remain unchanged. No unconditional topology or rounded-stability claim is inferred.

Only diagonal and upper blocks were assigned, leaving the returned F undefined below the diagonal. Step 3 now zeros every block at each start/restart, then overwrites diagonal/upper blocks only. Also explicitly gates each diagonal assignment on exact Jordan success and propagates invalid-certificate statuses, avoiding a missing branch. Exact Schur checks and successful local Sylvester uniqueness retain the original function contract; no rounded-stability claim is added.

F3 falsely attributed the exact recurrence to a rounded procedure, but that recurrence is already given in the Statement. F3 now explicitly records that given. Also added n>=1, required by the definition of sign(A) and the primary calculus; the original omitted it. The half-plane diagonal induction proves invertibility, the Cayley transform squares with spectral radius below one, and the error identity plus a bounded inverse proves local quadratic convergence. Removed the misleading contract F3 citation and supplier-interface claim under the shared lock.

The rounded procedure does not supply the exact recurrence attributed to it by F3. The Statement already gives the exact recurrence, so F3 now accurately records that given without changing the theorem. Added the trivial zero-dimensional proof branch to avoid an empty maximum; for n>=1 positive singular values follow the scalar Newton map, decrease to one after the first update, and give the claimed spectral-norm quadratic constant. Removed the misleading contract F3 citation and updated the proof-step and empty-case mirrors under the shared lock.

The original proof identified only diagonal and upper blocks, so its conclusion F=f(T) lacked equality below the diagonal. The supplier now initializes all lower blocks to zero; F1 and step 1.1 explicitly retain that invariant. Added the actual Jordan-success correctness supplier for F_ii=f(T_ii). Expanding GT=TG gives the stated plus/minus Sylvester recurrence, and successful-pivot uniqueness proves equality of upper blocks by distance induction. Statement unchanged; the manifest dependency and contract citation/step mirrors were updated under the shared lock.

The cited Pade Definition explicitly says in its closing paragraph to count every rounded real primitive of a square against the finite squaring budget and propagate budget-exhausted before an unaffordable operation. Thus proof 3.1 uses an actual before-primitive requirement, not merely a budget input. The dispatcher induction bounds executed prefixes, fixed audit loops are finite, supplied callback termination remains a premise, and each Schur-Parlett merge strictly reduces the block count. The repaired Schur initialization adds only finite zero copies and returned Jordan failures; no theorem edit is needed.
